paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: Paper reports a direct axion-electron coupling search using quantum nondemolition detection of magnons in a ferrimagnetic sphere coupled to a superconducting qubit. The upper limit g_aee < 2.6×10^-6 is obtained at 95% CL for axion mass range 33.117 µeV < m_a < 33.130 µeV. The limit is derived from null detection in qubit spectrum measurements. Local DM density ρ_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm³ and relative velocity v_tot = 220 km/s are assumed (standard galactic halo model). The coupling is mass-independent over the stated narrow mass range, encoded as a horizontal line. The paper analyzes background data from Ref.
